⚡ Asura Scans & Cloudflare Bypass Helper Scripts

Use these 1-click browser scripts whenever a site blocks public CORS proxies

Why is this needed? Sites like Asura Scans sometimes enable strict Cloudflare protection. If direct URL scanning is blocked, open the manga chapter in Chrome or Firefox and use either method below:

Method 1: 1-Click Image URL Extractor (Recommended)

1. Open your desired chapter on Asura Scans (or any manga website).
2. Press F12 (Inspect → Console), paste the script below, and press Enter—all manga page URLs will be copied to your clipboard automatically! Then paste them into the "HTML / Image List" tab here. 

(() => {
  const imgs = [...document.querySelectorAll('img')]
    .map(i => i.currentSrc || i.src || i.dataset.src)
    .filter(u => u && /storage\/media|chapter|uploads|manga|comic/i.test(u) && !/logo|avatar|icon|banner/i.test(u));
  const unique = [...new Set(imgs)];
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(unique.join('\n'));
  console.log('Copied ' + unique.length + ' manga pages!');
})();
Method 2: Direct In-Page PDF Generator Script

Run this script inside the browser Console on any open manga chapter page to compile and download the PDF directly on that tab without any proxy: 

(async () => {
  const s = document.createElement('script');
  s.src = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js';
  document.head.appendChild(s);
  await new Promise(r => s.onload = r);
  const { jsPDF } = window.jspdf;
  const imgs = [...document.querySelectorAll('img')].filter(i => i.naturalWidth > 350 && i.naturalHeight > 300);
  if (!imgs.length) return console.warn('No manga images found!');
  let pdf = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < imgs.length; i++) {
    const im = imgs[i];
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = im.naturalWidth; c.height = im.naturalHeight;
    c.getContext('2d').drawImage(im, 0, 0);
    const data = c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.9);
    const w = 210, h = (im.naturalHeight / im.naturalWidth) * w;
    if (i === 0) pdf = new jsPDF({ unit: 'mm', format: [w, h] });
    else pdf.addPage([w, h]);
    pdf.addImage(data, 'JPEG', 0, 0, w, h);
  }
  pdf.save((document.title || 'manga_chapter') + '.pdf');
})();
